article_notes: All 10 B. rossi dogs were fatal cases (died or euthanised) compared only with 4 healthy controls (liver histopathology, IHC and serum biochemistry). No comparison between severity or outcome groups. Infected-vs-control comparisons not extracted (Table 2 biochemistry, Tables 3-4 IHC markers, hemosiderin). Cohort shared with other organ studies from the same tissue bank (spleen, lung, bone marrow).
